sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

The above appeal is filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 02.01.2014 passed in MVC No.530/2012 by the II Additional District and Sessions Judge, MACT., Tumkur1 and seeking enhancement of the compensation awarded.

entities.text: II Additional District and Sessions Judge, MACT., Tumkur1
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. For the sake of convenience, the parties herein are referred as per their rank before the Tribunal.
3. The finding of the Tribunal on negligence and liability is not under challenge.
Hence, the only question required to be considered in the present appeal is as to the enhancement of compensation awarded by the Tribunal.
Hereinafter referred to as the 'Tribunal' NC: 2024:KHC:2273 4.
The claimant-appellant2 is stated to be aged 31 years as on the date of the accident i.e., on 23.1.2012.
Hence, appropriate multiplier to be applied is '15'.
The claimant is stated that he was doing agricultural work and is earning `10,000/-.
However, no material is produced to prove the income of the claimant.
Hence, the Tribunal has assessed the income as `4,500/- per month.

Having regard to the fact that no material has been produced by the claimant to prove the income,
the income is required to be re-assessed as notional income having regard to the chart followed for settlement of claims in the Lok Adalath conducted by the Legal Services Authority.
Hence, the income of the claimant is re
- assessed as `7,000/-.
5. It is forthcoming from the wound certificate (Ex.P4) that the claimant has sustained four injuries.
Injury Nos.1 to 3 were simple and injury No.4 i.e., dislocation of hip joint is grievous in nature.
It is forthcoming from the discharge card (Exs.P5 and P6) that the Tribunal was treated as an inpatient for a total period of 17 days.
Hereinafter referred to as 'the claimant' NC: 2024:KHC:2273 6.
Having regard to the aforementioned, the compensation is re
- assessed as follows:

2 6.1

entities.text: Raju S/O Shivanna vs Shivaprasad K G
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Tribunal has awarded a compensation of `20,000/- towards pain and suffering.
Having regard to the nature of injuries sustained, the same is re
- assessed at `30,000/-.
6.2 The Tribunal has awarded a compensation of `5,000/- towards conveyance and a sum of `6,000/- towards attendant charges and nourishing food.
It is just and proper that on both the heads the compensation is re-assessed as `20,000/- having regard to the nature of injuries sustained and the period of treatment.

6.3 The Tribunal has awarded a sum of `5,000/-
towards medical expenditure which is as per the actual bills and is just and proper.
6.4 The Tribunal has taken the laid up period as three months.
Hence, loss of income is required to be re-assessed at `21,000/- (`7,000 x 3) as against `13,500/- awarded by the Tribunal.
The Tribunal has awarded a sum of `20,000/- towards discomfort and loss of amenities.
Having regard to the nature of injuries sustained and the period of treatment, the same is re-assessed at `25,000/-.
6.6 The Tribunal has not assessed the disability.
It is forthcoming that the Doctor has been examined as PW.2 who has deposed regarding the treatment undertaken by the claimant.
PW.2 has also deposed the whole body disability is 19.66%.

The Doctor has been cross examined and he has stated regarding the fact that the claimant sustained dislocation of the left hip joint and has also stated that he has pain on left lower limb, cannot run fast, cannot left heavy weight and cannot squat for routine work.
PW.2 has also stated regarding the restriction in the movement in the left hip joint.
Having regard to the evidence of PW.2, it is just and proper that the disability is re-assessed at 15%.

Hence, loss of future earning capacity is assessed as `1,89,000/- (`7,000 x 12 x 15 x 15%)
7.

In view of the aforementioned, the compensation re-assessed is as follows:
NC: 2024:KHC:2273 Sl.No Compensation Head Amount Amount Awarded by awarded by the Tribunal this Court (`) (`) 1 Conveyance, attendant 11000.00 20000.00 charges and nourishing food 2 Pain and agony 20000.00 30000.00 3

Medical expenses 5000.00 5000.00 4 Loss of income during 13500.00 21000.00 laid up period 5 Discomfort and loss of 20000.00 25000.00 amenities 6 Loss of future earning 00 189000.00 capacity Total 69500 290000.00 8.
Accordingly, the Claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation of `2,20,500/- (`2,90,000 - `69,500/-).

9. In view of the aforementioned, I pass the following:
ORDER Raju S/O Shivanna vs Shivaprasad K G on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71313223/

ii) The judgment and award dated 02.01.2014 passed in MVC No.530/2012 by the II Addl. District and NC: 2024:KHC:2273 Sessions Judge and MACT., Tumkur, is hereby modified to the extent stated herein.
